name: opendexter
description: Discover x402 APIs, inspect current terms, use a passkey-controlled Dexter Wallet, and execute only explicitly bounded calls.

interface.shortDescription: Passkey wallet and safely bounded x402 API calls.
interface.longDescription:
OpenDexter connects the assistant to the hosted x402 marketplace and a passkey-controlled Dexter Wallet on Solana. It can search without paying, inspect the exact endpoint and current terms, and execute a paid call only after the user approves the URL, method, body, and maximum charge.

The hosted contract has ten tools. Search, price checks, wallet-proof access, wallet status, passkey compatibility, and reusable-skill workflows remain distinct from payment. The older card-tool roster is not part of this package; card controls remain on Dexter's secure wallet surface.

Protected tools use the MCP server's native OAuth contract. Wallet keys, passkey material, bearer tokens, one-time codes, and other authentication secrets never belong in the conversation. Ambiguous or post-dispatch payment results are never retried automatically.
defaultPrompt: Find an x402 API for this job and show me its current terms.
Draft a reusable skill for this x402 provider without publishing it.
